notes:
Refers to both the position itself and the person holding it. In Japanese companies, {管理職|かんりしょく} typically includes section chiefs and above. A key distinction is that {管理職|かんりしょく} employees are often exempt from overtime pay under Japanese labor law.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {管理職|かんりしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧: to take a management position
- {管理職|かんりしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be promoted to management
- {管理職|かんりしょく}⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧: management allowance
- ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧{管理職|かんりしょく}: female manager
- {中間|ちゅうかん}{管理職|かんりしょく}: middle management

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{役職|やくしょく}→役職：05514_yakushoku⟧: job title or official position — broader than {管理職|かんりしょく}, covering any titled position
- ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧: boss, superior — refers to the person above you, not the position itself

definitions.explanation: a managerial or supervisory position within an organization; a person who holds such a position
